_about: Advisories the weekly dependency audit (scripts/dependency-audit/report.mjs) treats as dismissed. Only a critical advisory fails the job, and only until its reviewBy date: after that date the entry dismisses nothing until someone reviews it again. Each entry needs the GitHub advisory id, the package, a reason and a review date (YYYY-MM-DD). Remove an entry when the audit stops reporting it.

dismissed.reason: No fixed version exists: every node-forge release up to 1.4.0 is affected and none is patched. It is reached only through Expo's command-line tools in apps/mobile (expo > @expo/cli and @expo/code-signing-certificates), which run on a developer machine or the EAS build server; it is not in the phone app's bundle or on the web server.
